defects: Uses `μ.totalVar` instead of Mathlib's actual declaration `SignedMeasure.totalVariation`; `totalVar` does not appear to be a real Mathlib identifier, so the statement likely does not type-check as written

Changes the inequality from an ℝ≥0∞ statement using the extended norm (`‖s i‖ₑ ≤ s.totalVariation i`, where totalVariation is a Measure applied to a set) to an ℝ-valued statement using absolute value and an explicit cast (`|μ s| ≤ ↑(μ.totalVar s)`); this silently relies on finiteness/coercion behavior of totalVariation that isn't expressed or justified in the statement itself, making the correspondence to the gold's enorm-based formulation unverifiable
Carrier type is made explicit (`(α : Type*)`) rather than implicit as in gold (`{X : Type*}`), a minor signature deviation
